global_card_rules.style: Surface background (#F5F6F8), 1px line border (#B9D8F0), 24px internal padding
global_card_rules.image: object-contain, 16:9 or 4:3 aspect ratio, white background behind image
global_card_rules.hover: Border transitions to steel/30, subtle shadow elevation
global_card_rules.typography: Title: 16px bold navy · Body: 13px steel · Tags: 10px navy/60
global_card_rules.never: Identical card heights forced by CSS grid, pure white cards without surface bg, cards without images

global_image_rules.format: object-contain for equipment, object-cover for scenes
global_image_rules.background: white or surface behind all product/equipment images
global_image_rules.labels: All factory images must have location/capability overlay
global_image_rules.consistency: Same image style within each section — don't mix cutout PNG with scene photos
